title: Iceland's no vote does not undermine the EU's appeal
subhead: Driven in part by concerns over reopening the issue of fishing rights, the Icelandic referendum at the end of August disappointed supporters of European integration. Yet the EU continues to be seen as a stable regional center of governance that many other partners still want to draw closer to.

title: Europe sidelined by SpaceX's dominance in space, as French-German rivalries deepen
subhead: Initiated by the French president, the International Space Summit taking place in Paris on September 9 and 10 reveals the divisions between Paris and Berlin, fueled by industrial ambitions and geopolitical tensions.

subhead: The Georges Pauilhac mansion, a stunning Art Nouveau building, is set to be sold in November. Starting price: €2.1 million.

title: In the French presidential campaign, the issue of wages is no laughing matter
subhead: The image of French business leaders laughing at presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon's proposal to raise the minimum wage has become a symbol of the tensions surrounding the issue of earnings and cost of living in France.

Why loneliness is now seen as a harmful epidemic for mental and physical health
subhead: In France, nearly one in four people reported feeling lonely in 2025. This isolation particularly affects young people and the elderly, and could be a significant source of suffering. Among the possible ways to counter it are taking part in local activities and encouraging more volunteering.
